experiment.name: E44_v5_2_shared_write_state
experiment.objective: Reduce redundant write-acknowledgment FFs; preserve payload storage, arithmetic and throughput
experiment.baseline_PnR: Reuse archived, hash-verified v5.1 candidate implementation; same options
experiment.adoption_rule: All functional/timing/throughput gates, FF reduction >=2%, LUT/DSP/BRAM/CLB no increase

control_scope: Archived E43/v5.1 routed core and all-coefficient stress outputs; immutable source/report digests verified, identical physical options

local_state_proof.proof: Within each existing FIFO group, equal zero initialization and identical clock/reset, producer done/continue, full flag and state update imply equal per-channel acknowledgment state by induction. Replace follower states with the group leader. No assumption of unstalled traffic.

accuracy_scope: Reuse v5.1 PA metrics after exact 7680-sample output equality; no retraining or new PA run
